recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. It is a narrow template-only correction for active resource pages and preserves the existing full-list, extension-registry, common-parameter, and Searching links while satisfying the published Jira request.
issue_request: FHIR-38728 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked that resource search pages and the search parameter section on each resource content page mention the SearchParameter registry, including guidance for common parameters and search result modifiers that apply across resources.
initial_application: Git commit b7e37c11e1a1480180a2265381dac9c31e443ce1 initially applied FHIR-38728 by changing tools/templates/template.html and tools/templates/template-search.html to add resource search guidance and extension-registry links. The current templates still linked to common search guidance and extension-search placeholders, but they did not directly link to searchparameter-registry.html.
additional_context: FHIR-20762 is a related Published/Persuasive-with-Modification search-parameter discoverability issue cited in the FHIR-38728 Jira comment. The FHIR-I 2022-12-12 minutes corroborate the FHIR-38728 Persuasive vote. The core search chapter already says all common and resource-specific SearchParameters defined in the specification are listed in the registry, so the resource-page fix aligns generated resource pages with that central text.
reconciliation: Updated tools/templates/template.html and tools/templates/template-search.html to link resource-page search prose to searchparameter-registry.html and to mention search result parameters alongside the existing common-parameter guidance.
source_changes: tools/templates/template.html: added searchparameter-registry.html and search.html#modifyingresults links to the resource content-page Search Parameters section.
tools/templates/template-search.html: added the same registry and search result parameter guidance to resource-specific search pages.
